name: Under Pressure
description: Inside a chaotic emergency room in Rio de Janeiro, a team of doctors are torn between their internal personal conflicts, the difficulties of the profession and the surprising dramas behind each patient‘s history, in a heroic attempt to save lives...See more

videos.title: COVID Watch - Part 1
videos.overview: After a period on a humanitarian mission, Carolina and Evandro are called in to work in a field hospital set up to treat patients infected with Covid-19.

videos.title: COVID Watch - Part 2
videos.overview: At the hospital, patients and medical staff fight for their lives. Evandro recalls his youth, when he began his medical career. The reasons that led him to become a doctor are revealed.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Dr. Evandro decides to operate on his own wife. Time passes. The team treats a pregnant woman who was struck by a vehicle. Carolina kisses Evandro.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Evandro questions Carolina about a scar. A teenager attempts suicide at the hospital. A radio host is torn between faith and medicine.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A mother is reluctant to authorize taking her brain-dead son off life support. Dr. Charles investigates the background of a foreign patient.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: A domestic violence victim fears reporting her husband. Dr. Evandro comes to the aid of a blind man and tries to save his guide dog. Amir is nearly exposed.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Doctors need to remove a stray bullet that struck an elderly woman's heart. A man fears he has transmitted HIV to his pregnant wife.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Carolina catches Evandro with Jaqueline. Accident victims flood the hospital. A doctor defies a court order. Carolina is threatened.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Dr. Evandro testifies before the Federal Council of Medicine. A shootout occurs at the hospital. Dr. Carolina is suspended and reunites with her father. Dr. Rafael makes a revelation.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Carolina reveals her trauma. Evandro testifies about his wife's death and makes a discovery.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Evandro comes to Carolina's aid at the apartment. The doctor receives a job offer.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A shootout further intensifies the pressure of the shift. Evandro is kidnapped and forced to treat a criminal wounded in the confrontation.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Carolina and Evandro get married but postpone their trip because of a patient. Henrique, a new orthopedist, arrives at the hospital. Décio searches for the mother of an abandoned baby.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A new emergency puts Carolina and Evandro's romantic plans on hold. Meanwhile, Décio considers adopting the abandoned baby, and a police officer who has been shot is admitted to the hospital.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Carolina's father is admitted to the emergency room and treated by Evandro. The Department of Health proposes Renata as the hospital's new administrator. Décio helps a transgender patient.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Carolina is involved in a bus accident; Evandro rushes to the scene, neglecting a patient who subsequently dies. At the hospital, Renata, the new director, implements changes.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Carolina misdiagnoses a child, reigniting her harmful behavior. Evandro, who is away from the hospital, assists Charles with a surgery via video conference.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: A child's parents refuse treatment on religious grounds, and Evandro fights to save the child. Renata tries to corrupt Henrique.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: A child's parents refuse treatment on religious grounds, and Evandro fights to save the child. Renata tries to corrupt Henrique.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: A woman and her son injured by a large firework and a young man with a stab wound are admitted to the emergency room. After arguing with Renata, Samuel falls ill, and Carolina tries to help the doctor.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Carolina suspects that Renata interfered with Samuel's treatment. Meanwhile, the doctors attend to a member of the Doctors of Joy group.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Henrique reveals Renata's corruption scheme to Carolina and Evandro, who report the director to the Federal Police. Evandro is arrested, and Carolina seeks evidence to free her husband.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: As SAMU doctors, Evandro and Carolina turn to São Tomé Hospital during an emergency amidst the truck drivers' strike. The care provided there completely changes the couple's plans.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Infectious disease specialist Vera joins the team on a tense day. Evandro needs to treat a patient shot by the militia, while Carolina attends to a young woman and Charles encounters a medical error.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Evandro and Carolina come to the aid of a stabbed woman and her attacker. At São Tomé, Charles receives a visit from his ex-girlfriend, who falls ill.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Charles and Evandro race against time to treat a skydiver with a brain aneurysm who fainted during a jump, and a child with kidney failure who needs a transplant. Meanwhile, Décio gets involved with a patient.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Faced with trauma, a girl who saw her mother injured in an explosion falls silent, making Carolina's job difficult. Meanwhile, Evandro treats a young man who was beaten up at school. Contact with meningitis patients creates a dramatic situation in Carolina's life.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The hospital receives victims of a landslide. Among the patients, a fortune teller reveals what fate holds in store for Carolina. Intrigued, she seeks answers about the future.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The arrival of a pregnant inmate brings Vera's past to the surface and stirs up Carolina's emotions. Meanwhile, Charles and Décio treat a breast cancer patient and must deal with a drastic decision made by her niece.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The assaulted teacher is treated by Evandro, who lavishes care on Carolina. Evandro meets Diana, who accuses him of medical error, while Vera treats a man with cancer and decides to admit him to the hospital.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Evandro deals with an offer of help from the militia amidst a shortage of resources for patient care. He is approached by Diana, who is depressed. The two grow closer.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Wounded, the militia leader storms the hospital and forces Carolina to treat him. When the police discover his whereabouts, an intense shootout puts everyone's lives at risk.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Evandro saves a boy, while Carolina’s life is in danger. Vera tells Seu João the truth and promises to look after him. Carolina and Evandro suffer a blow that destabilizes their relationship.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Carolina and Evandro disagree over a patient. Reconciliation becomes impossible. Evandro suffers a relapse, and Carolina shows signs of shaken faith.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Evandro and Carolina quarrel. Mr. João confronts Vera with an issue from the past. Drugs interfere with Evandro, who seeks out Diana. Carolina gets involved with a man and resigns.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: On her last day, Carolina performs surgery with Evandro. On the way to the hotel, he uses drugs and his life is put at risk. Carolina fights to save him.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Evandro is injured while trying to help a man who has been stabbed. At the hospital, a woman faints at the reception desk. Hungry, her son grabs a sandwich and is restrained by the police.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: A pedestrian struck by a car and the vehicle's passengers arrive at the emergency department. Mauro is the new chief. Vera's son steals his mother's prescription pad, and Evandro receives a call from Diana.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Diana arrives with a very sick baby. Everyone suspects the baby is Evandro's. While dealing with urgent cases, the doctors decide the baby needs surgery.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: A grandstand collapses, and the injured flood the hospital. Vera discovers that her son has stolen prescription pads. The doctor treats elderly patients with HIV, and Evandro promises to look after Francisco.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: A fire causes patients to be transferred. Décio and his boyfriend suffer prejudice and the situation gets out of control. Amidst the chaos, Evandro looks for Francisco.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Carolina and Evandro search for Diana. Despite the damage caused by the fire, a young man arrives at the hospital in critical condition. Vera's son falls ill, and the young man's father confronts the doctor.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Mauro and Vera encounter a family issue involving a patient. Carolina visits Diana, who is depressed. A patient meets another patient via an app and becomes captivated by her.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The doctors treat a cancer patient and a young man who was the victim of a racist prank. Diana wants to see Francisco, but Evandro won't allow it. Carolina helps out, leaving the doctor disappointed.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Carolina goes to Vera's house. At the hospital, Evandro fears losing custody of his son. Mauro runs into the young person suffering from pain due to a medical error. William's condition worsens.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Evandro is taken aback by a witness at the hearing. At the hospital, doctors treat a pregnant young woman who is a victim of sexual abuse and a man with leptospirosis. Mauro asks Vera out.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Shooting victims are taken to the hospital. Evandro is performing surgery when Diana brings her son to say goodbye. Maria is distressed by her grandson's condition.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The team treats victims of an explosion, while Décio deals with his relationship. Livia learns that her husband has lost his job, and Evandro discovers his father's whereabouts.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: A flashback reveals Evandro's past; he is moved by a man rejected by his daughter. Vera deals with a woman trying to save her husband, and Décio makes a difficult decision.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Heleno suffers from Alzheimer's. At the hospital, Charles asks Evandro for help, while Carolina tends to a patient and Rosa organizes a send-off for Décio. Heleno is taken to the hospital.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Amidst urgent cases, Evandro deals with his father's illness—requiring hospitalization—while Carolina worries about her own health.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: A young man is assaulted after being mistaken for a thief. Carolina, affected by the diagnosis, seeks out a specialist. The doctor is also treating a patient suffering from complications following liposuction.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: A patient with hoarding disorder suffers from respiratory failure. A decision impacts hospital operations, and a tragedy shakes everyone. Evandro discovers Carolina's problem.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Unaware of the truth, Heleno seeks out Charles. A boy injured by a kite string and a couple involved in an accident arrive at the hospital. Overcome with guilt, Carolina cuts herself and asks Daniel for help.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Carolina is in pain, and Evandro asks her to schedule the surgery. Daniel seeks her out, and Evandro feels jealous. Heleno mistakes Rosa for his ex-wife, and Livia receives an illegal proposal.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Heleno's condition worsens. Evandro is surprised to find photos of his father. The hospital is stormed, and a staff member is injured. Daniel confesses that he still has feelings for Carolina.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: As her surgery approaches, Carolina gets help from Daniel with a patient, making Evandro jealous. She opens up to her husband about her feelings. Vera drinks at the hospital, and Mauro notices; she tries to kiss him.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Evandro speaks with Daniel about Carolina, who is dealing with difficult patient cases. Mauro tries to help Vera, but she avoids him. Daniel decides against operating on Carolina, who gets into an argument with Evandro.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Mauro and Vera want to go public with their relationship. On the day of Carolina's surgery, Daniel suspects the cancer has spread. Her life is at risk during the procedure.
